thread_text:
ana: Quick heads-up — Voxium interview scheduled tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need legal on release + final quote by EOD today. Recording via Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789
brian: Can we get a one-sentence customer bio and a 2–3 sentence use case? I'll draft placeholder quotes.
kim_legal: @ana send full customer legal name and org entity. We need explicit release for quotes + logo. Public or gated asset? :eyes:
nana: Public — they signed off on blog + social. Legal name: Voxium, Inc. Contact: Sarah Chen (VP Product). Copy of consent email pasted below.
nana: "Sarah confirms: 'Voxium is happy to be featured; please share final quote for approval.'"
kim_legal: Ok. That's fine but we need it in email thread or signed doc. I'll send our standard release: https://drive.redwood/release-templates/marketing-release.docx
zach_prod: Recording logistics: can we book 45m? Proposal: 20m interview, 10m demo capture, 10m quote extraction + buffer. Need transcript for quote pulls.
leo_eng: I'll take demo portion. Also, what model variant are we calling out? We shouldn't attribute numbers to 'canary' accidentally.
brian: Draft run-of-show: 1) Intro (2m) 2) Problem + Use case (8m) 3) Demo (10m) 4) Results & metrics (8m) 5) Quotes (10m) 6) Wrap (2m). Thoughts?
nana: Posting plan: blog + benchmark sidebar + 60s clip for X/LinkedIn. Target publish date: 2025-03-30. Need final quotes by 2025-03-20.
kim_legal: Quick Q — are we including performance numbers (TPS/latency) that reference Redwood infra? If yes, we need a privacy/data-source check and customer sign-off on numbers.
leo_eng: Current run numbers: Dedicated deployment on 4x A10G. p50 latency ~65ms for 1024 tokens. We can redact infra specifics if legal prefers.
kim_legal: Send me exact phrasing for metrics. I'll review and confirm what can be public. CC ops-bot for any infra log requests.
nana: First-pass quote: "Voxium has reduced query latency by 3x since migrating to Redwood Dedicated, enabling real-time suggestions in production." Feedback?
brian: Love it. Suggest toning to 'over 2.5x' until we lock down the final metrics. Less likely to require revisions.
nana: Updated: "over 2.5x" — uploaded draft: https://drive.redwood/voxium/assets/quote-draft.docx
kim_legal: Approving pending signed release + metric confirmation. I'll reach out to Sarah with the legal approval template.
zach_prod: I'll ensure we capture high-quality audio and upload an Otter.ai transcript after recording. Will also tag takes for social clips.
nana: Can everyone confirm by 5pm PT today so we don't slide the publish window? If legal needs more time we'll move publish.
kim_legal: Confirmed. Will get legal approval and signed release by 4:30pm PT. :white_check_mark:
brian: I'll prep the landing CTA and inbound lead routing: HubSpot -> sales@ -> AE East for high-intent leads. Need Sarah's referral contact for handoff.
nana: Sarah said she'll share a partner contact for the intro. I'll post final handoff details post-publish.
ops-bot: Reminder: add campaign tag 'voxium-2025' to all UTM links and update HubSpot workflow with source=customer_story.
nana: Thanks all — marking as blocked until legal release attached. Once legal email + signed release are in, I'll move to recording + design.
kim_legal: Update: Received signed release from Sarah at 15:42. Legal clears the quote as written. :tada:
nana: Awesome — moving to production prep.
